WITH invoice_averages AS (
  SELECT ft.invoice_number, c.gender, AVG(ft.transaction_amount) AS invoice_avg
  FROM Financial_Transactions AS ft
  JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.invoice_number = ft.invoice_number
  JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
  JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  GROUP BY ft.invoice_number, c.gender
),
gender_averages AS (
  SELECT gender, AVG(invoice_avg) AS gender_avg
  FROM invoice_averages
  GROUP BY gender
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(gender_avg) AS overall_avg
  FROM gender_averages
),
kept AS (
  SELECT g.gender_avg, g.gender_avg - o.overall_avg AS excess
  FROM gender_averages AS g
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
  WHERE g.gender_avg > o.overall_avg
)
SELECT AVG(gender_avg), AVG(excess)
FROM kept
